name: fl-studio
description: Control FL Studio from Claude: produce tracks fast, mix and master with measurements, drive any plugin in real units, and do what the scripting API cannot.

license_key.title: Licence key
license_key.description: Only for the credit-based tools; leave empty otherwise.

port.title: MIDI port name
port.description: The virtual MIDI port FL Studio listens on.
